address: Domaine de Murtoli, Vallée de l'Ortolo, Sartène, 20100, France
bio: Murtoli defies classification in classical tourist terms. Poised between the sea and the hills, this huge property dotted with stone houses boasting private pools is the height of rural luxury and combines modernity with the charm of traditional Corsican architecture. Whether you choose the concise or the tasting menu, you will sample a splendid tribute to fine Corsican produce, most of which is from the estate: vegetables, cheese, honey, veal, lamb and olive oil.
